shared_elements: rows of repeated small signs or geometric motifs
schematic relief/outline figures on a decorated surface
justification: The main correspondence is very general: both surfaces organize small repeated marks and motifs in horizontal bands/registers, with schematic linear relief forms. The biggest difference is iconographic: A is dominated by an arched inscribed panel with formal standing human/divine figures, while B is dominated by profile animals and abstract symbols arranged on a pillar-like surface.
